description: How two shared read-only DAO sessions in two processes share the lock file (R-LOCK-2 RO-PAIR: it grows 64 -> 128 B): which byte ranges each session holds locked, and what the file holds when both are open and after the second closes. Participant a opens r-cursor-1-nav shared read-only; b opens it the same way; a bisects [0, 2^62) of the .laccdb with exclusive fail-immediately LockFileEx requests through its own native handle and reads the file's first 256 bytes; b closes; a scans and reads again; a closes. Both files are kept at each scan. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: W-10/native-readers-only RO-PAIR: second session slot 2 at 0x10000002, record at 64; departed record stays; last close deletes
